description: Corrections to the Prop 123 Land Banking rows of ledger.json, keyed by fiscal year and the ledger's own (wrong) project name. scripts/funding/build_land_banking_awards.py applies them and stops if any corrected value is missing from the round's PDF text or if a key matches no ledger row. printed_as gives the pieces of a cell that the PDF prints on separate lines, joined by ' | '. An entry with only a note leaves the row as the ledger read it and adds the note.
